about: One line of the history file of a project: the record of a run of the whole suite by feature verify or release verify (`entry_kind` suite), or of the report that qargi review check read from a run that returns a report (`review`). The file is history/PROJECT.jsonl in the state. It is evidence, never a gate: no verb decides from it. A line is written once and never changed. `qargi history show ID --json` prints one entry, in the form it was stored. The fields marked with x-when belong to one entry_kind; a reader ignores a field it does not know. A number is a JSON integer, so a load average is the text of /proc/loadavg.
writes: Nothing: history show only reads the file. (The entries are written by feature verify, release verify and review check; see the reference page of the history.)

entry_kind.description: What the entry records: `suite` a whole-suite run of feature verify or release verify, `review` the report of a report-only run that qargi review check read. A reader treats a word it does not know as `unknown` and ignores the entry.

id.description: 16 random hex digits: the name by which `qargi history show ID` and a log of a run (suite-logs/runs/ID.log) cite the entry.

project.description: The stored project; the file of the entry is history/PROJECT.jsonl.

time.description: When the entry was made, UTC. For a suite entry it is `ended`.

name.description: The feature name (feature verify) or the version (release verify).

branch.description: The branch whose head was run (the release branch, or the base branch when the release has none).

tree.description: The tree of that commit: two heads with one tree are one content.

command.description: The command identity the run is keyed by: the project's test command, or the identity of the declared gates (what `verified` compares).

environment_id.description: The id of verify.environment, null when the setting is off (the second half of what `verified` compares).

gates.description: Each declared gate in the order declared; empty when the run had no declared gates.

result.description: `interrupted`: the verb ended before it had a verdict (a signal, or a stop after the run such as a launcher that left no report).

seconds.description: Whole seconds of the run, as the per-branch record of the run has them.

queue_wait_s.description: Whole seconds, rounded up, that the run waited in the queue of the whole-suite runs (`qargi suite status`) before its suite started; 0 when it did not wait. Not counted in `seconds`, and an entry written before the queue has no such field.

failing_tests.description: At most 200 names, each cut at 300 characters. The failing-test lines the summary of a failed verify prints (FAIL, FAIL: and --- FAIL: lines of the log), in the order they appear, without repeats.

failing_total.description: How many such lines the log held, which is more than the length of failing_tests when the list was cut.

load_start.description: The first field of /proc/loadavg when the run started, as the text it has (a document holds integers only); null when it cannot be read.

load_end.description: The same when the run ended.

attempt.description: 1 plus the number of earlier suite entries of this project with the same head, tree, command and environment_id.

log.description: The path of the kept log, suite-logs/runs/ID.log; null when it could not be kept. The newest 20 logs of a project stay, and the log of the latest pass of each branch; a path may name a log that was removed since.

run.description: The run directory name of the reviewed run (qargi.XXXXXX).

verdict.description: The last line of the report.

report_sha256.description: The sha256 of the bytes of the report; the text of the report is never stored.

base.description: The base branch of the run, as the lead's registry records it.

base_sha.description: The commit the run was cut from; `qargi history --head` finds a review by it.

role.description: The role of the reviewer, as the registry records it.

class.description: The class of the role (read-only for a report-only run).

runtime.description: The runtime the run was prepared for, as the registry records it; null when it records none.

model.description: The model asked for at prepare, never one a runtime reported.

vendor.description: The family name that the descriptor of the runtime gives; null when the runtime has no descriptor or no family.

tests_run.description: What the reviewer's manifest records under tests_run (a list of names or a count); null when it records none.

result.description: pass, fail, not run, or `covered by NAME`.

seconds.description: Whole seconds; null for a gate that did not run.
